name: Nizofenone
summary: Nizofenone (Ekonal, Midafenone) is a neuroprotective drug which protects neurons from death following cerebral anoxia (interruption of oxygen supply to the brain). It might thus be useful in the treatment of acute neurological conditions such as stroke.

uses.text: It might thus be useful in the treatment of acute neurological conditions such as stroke.

fact.en: It was developed in Japan to protect brain cells when their oxygen supply is cut off, as happens in a stroke.
fact.zh: 它在日本研發，目的是在腦細胞的氧氣供應中斷時（例如中風）保護這些細胞。
fact.zhHans: 它在日本研发，目的是在脑细胞的氧气供应中断时（例如中风）保护这些细胞。
